text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert: Reserved GPU pool resv-eu-1 at 97% utilization for 14m. Queue growth + throttles observed. Affected: enterprise tenant CrestlineBio (reserved allocation). Auto-scale attempts failing. Severity: P1. Paging oncall. thread_ts=4600002468

sam (oncall): On it. joining bridge now. linking runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/reserved-pool-exhaustion (reading) 

alex (sre): quick check — is this noisy tenant or many small tenants? can someone paste top-allocs from metrics?

maria (platform): Grafana snapshot: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/ri-pools/resv-eu-1?from=now-30m&to=now -- crestlinebio is at ~63% of the pool alone, second biggest tenant is ~12%. Query used: `sum by(tenant) (gpu_reserved_percent{pool="resv-eu-1"})`

sam (oncall): nice, sounds like crestlinebio is running long-lived training/finetune jobs in reserved slot. listing active sessions:
```
$ redwoodctl sessions list --pool resv-eu-1 --fields tenant,session_id,age,cuda_mem
crestlinebio  sess-0a3  22h  23GB
crestlinebio  sess-0b7  19h  24GB
crestlinebio  sess-1c9  3h   6GB
othercust     sess-9z1  2h   5GB
```

devops-bot: autoscaler: scale attempt failed: cloud_api_error: QuotaExceeded (requested 4 more GPUs). attempt_id=ae3f2. Suggestion: check cloud quota or fallback pool.

alex (sre): autoscaler hitting account GPU quota. that's why scale didn't kick. we need a mitigation path that doesn't rely on cloud quota increase (fast path) — options: 1) throttle crestlinebio background jobs 2) evict idle sessions they can reprovision later 3) offload lower-priority tasks to hosted pool.

katie (cs): crestlinebio support contact: ops@crestlinebio.com. I'm drafting a brief note to tell them we're throttling background training and will coordinate. want to cc account exec.

sam (oncall): going to apply tenant-level soft-throttle for crestlinebio for 30m. will patch route config to limit concurrent sessions to reserved quota. command coming up.

sam (oncall): applying patch:
```
$ redwoodctl tenant update crestlinebio --pool resv-eu-1 --concurrency-limit 6 --burst 2
PATCH OK: config applied -> rollout id r-9921
```

deploy-bot: rollout r-9921 deployed to gateway nodes (3/3), traffic shifting.

incidents-bot: update: 5m after throttle, resv-eu-1 utilization = 88% (down from 97%). queue length reduced 40%.

maria (platform): checked autoscaler logs — root cause: cloud provider returned `RESOURCE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED` for new node requests and our fallback region also at limit. We should file quota increase but that's multi-hour. For now, apply eviction of long-running sessions from crestlinebio that are non-interactive.

alex (sre): agree. identify sessions >4h and mark for eviction with 10m grace. sam run eviction.

sam (oncall): running eviction: 
```
$ redwoodctl sessions evict --pool resv-eu-1 --tenant crestlinebio --min-age 4h --grace 600
Evicting 2 sessions: sess-0a3, sess-0b7
Eviction started -> job j-1145
```

deploy-bot: eviction job j-1145 progress: 2/2 sessions drained. tasks were checkpointed (ok).

katie (cs): just emailed CrestlineBio ops: "we're throttling non-interactive jobs and evicting long-running sessions to stabilize your reserved pool. if you have urgent long jobs, let us know and we'll coordinate timing." they replied: "thanks, pausing background runs now, will follow up"

devops-bot: note: some evicted workloads attempted immediate restart and hit `quota_exceeded` again when provisioning new nodes. we've temporarily blocked auto-restart for evicted sessions on crestlinebio to avoid thrash.

sam (oncall): temporary measure: set tenant restart-backoff to 15m for crestlinebio.
```
$ redwoodctl tenant update crestlinebio --restart-backoff 15m
OK
```

incidents-bot: update: 25m after initial alert, utilization 69%. queue drained. no customer facing errors observed for most API calls but higher latency for large-batch jobs from crestlinebio (they were briefly impacted).

maria (platform): follow-ups: 1) open cloud quota ticket (region eu-west-2) 2) implement a pool fairness limiter to avoid single-tenant >50% of reserved pool 3) add autoscaler circuit to detect quota rejections and fallback to prioritized eviction before attempt. I'll create infra ticket.

alex (sre): I'll own immediate post-incident task: create a short RCA doc and track follow-ups. created INC-4600: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-4600 — assigned to jason (infra) for quota and to me for fairness limiter.

jason (infra): got it. will file cloud quota request and schedule a 1hr slot to coordinate with cloud support. also will scope quick fix for tenant soft-fairness (rate-limiter) — ETA EOD.

katie (cs): putting a short customer note in crestlinebio's CSM thread: "we mitigated a reserved pool saturation event by throttling and evicting long-running background sessions; we're following up with a quota increase and policy changes to prevent recurrence."

sam (oncall): closing active bridge. leaving incident open for follow-ups. final state: pool stable, crestlinebio throttled temporary, quota ticket filed. owners: jason=cloud/quota, alex=fairness & RCA, maria=deploy follow-ups, katie=customer comms. :white_check_mark:

incidents-bot: incident summary saved to INC-4600. please add notes to the RCA template: https://redwood.internal/rca-templates/resv-exhaustion.

alex (sre): thanks all. postmortem assigned, please add any logs/screenshots to INC-4600. I'll schedule a 1h retro tomorrow.

sam (oncall): if anything re-grows, ping me. otherwise marking this thread resolved. :thumbsup:
